_meta.title: rustypi Feature Tracker
_meta.description: Tracks feature status for the rustypi Rust coding agent

features.name: Project Setup & Baseline
features.description: Confirm cargo build, cargo test, ./init.sh, and --self-test all pass from a clean checkout
features.evidence: cargo build --release (2.6 MB), cargo test passes, --self-test passes

features.name: Core Agent Loop
features.description: System prompt → user task → LLM tool calls → tool execution → feedback loop terminates correctly
features.evidence: run_agent in ai_core/mod.rs, verified by --self-test (fake SSE server)

features.name: LLM Streaming & SSE
features.description: Streaming responses via reqwest SSE, JSON fragment accumulation for tool-call arguments
features.evidence:
chat_stream in ai_core/llm.rs, handles 

 and 

 delimiters, per-index argument accumulation

features.name: Tool Implementations
features.description: read_file, write_file, edit_file, run_command, ask_user tools work correctly and report errors
features.evidence: ai_core/tools.rs, 5 tools, edit_file enforces unique match, run_command platform-aware

features.name: Model Config & CLI
features.description: model.json persistence, --list, --use, --add, --url/--key/--model flags, LLM_URL/LLM_KEY/LLM_MODEL env vars
features.evidence: config.rs, interactive add when empty, EOF-safe prompts, profiles with default pointer

features.name: TUI Mode
features.description: --tui flag launches pi-style main-screen TUI with synchronized output (CSI 2026), differential rendering, live streaming transcript, ask_user input box, Esc quits
features.evidence: src/tui/ module (mod/app/render/plain), main-screen (no alternate screen), diff rendering with RenderState, CSI 2026 for atomic frames, plain stream fallback for piped stdin

features.name: Self-Test
features.description: --self-test runs offline check with fake server, no network required
features.evidence: ai_core/mod.rs self_test(), fake SSE server with 2 requests, sync tool assertions, session tree checks

features.name: Session Persistence & Tree Branching
features.description: session.json with tree structure (id/parentId), active leaf, --tree browser (pi-style main-screen + diff rendering), --resume, pi-style branching
features.evidence: session.rs (Entry/Session), tree.rs (main-screen diff renderer + plain list), --tree/--resume in main.rs

features.name: Live LLM Integration
features.description: Tested against local LLM server (localhost:20128), model profiles with API key, streaming works end-to-end
features.evidence: model.json with mimo-v2.5-pro default, key persisted, streaming verified via curl and rustypi CLI

features.name: TUI Experience: semantic status + spinner + editing + scrollback + slash commands
features.description: Semantic status symbols/colors (⠋ working, ✓ success, ✗ failure, ⚠ warn, ℹ info, cyan › prompt), animated spinner, cursor editing + history recall, PageUp/PageDown scrollback, /use /resume /tree slash commands, input overflow window, user lines flush-left with dim number + cyan caret
features.evidence: tools.rs returns (bool,String); Event::ToolStart/ToolEnd/TaskEnd; Job enum (Task/Model/Resume/Tree); cursor/history/scroll fields in App; SPINNER frames in render.rs; colorize_row semantic colors; self-test green

features.name: Interrupt Key Model (pi-style)
features.description: Esc interrupts the running agent (cooperative AtomicBool checked between iterations and per stream chunk), Ctrl+C clears input, Ctrl+D exits when input empty; interrupted turns show '⚠ interrupted'; quit no longer waits for in-flight turn
features.evidence: cancel: Arc<AtomicBool> shared TUI<->agent; run_agent/chat_stream take &AtomicBool; self-test asserts pre-set flag returns Err("interrupted") before any network call
